exposure: age at menarche (categorized as <= 12, 13, 14, and >= 15 years)
cohort: The study involved 4227 pregnant women who gave birth at The First Affiliated Hospital of Chengdu Medical College between January 2017 and December 2022.
finding: Pregnant women who had an age at menarche of ≤ 12 years had a higher risk of preeclampsia and adverse neonatal outcomes compared to women with later menarche.
